title: Saudi Arabian Lentil Kebabs
description: A flavorful and healthy keto dish inspired by Saudi Arabian cuisine, featuring tender lentil kebabs grilled to perfection.

ingredients.name: Aromatic Spices
ingredients.notes: Use a blend of Middle Eastern spices such as cumin, coriander, and paprika

instructions: 1. Rinse the lentils and soak them in water for at least 4 hours.
2. Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
3. In a large bowl, mix together the lentils, aromatic spices, and Saudi Arabian grill spice.
4. Add the olive oil and mix well.
5. Thread the lentil mixture onto skewers.
6. Grill the kebabs for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the lentils are tender.
7. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve hot.
